name: teziovsky-utilities
description: Teziovsky Utilities — native macOS app to organize iCloud Photos albums and finalize drone footage projects
author: teziovsky

scripts.clean: rm -rf build dist && xcodebuild -project TeziovskyUtilities.xcodeproj -scheme TeziovskyUtilities -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData clean
scripts.build: xcodebuild -project TeziovskyUtilities.xcodeproj -scheme TeziovskyUtilities -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.clean:build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
scripts.build:production: xcodebuild -project TeziovskyUtilities.xcodeproj -scheme TeziovskyUtilities -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.release: pnpm run build:production && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && ditto build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Release/TeziovskyUtilities.app dist/TeziovskyUtilities.app && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent dist/TeziovskyUtilities.app dist/TeziovskyUtilities-macOS.zip && echo 'Release artifacts: dist/TeziovskyUtilities.app dist/TeziovskyUtilities-macOS.zip'
